subject: CONTROL clause
notes: kb/Work PB205. Previously rejected as a side effect under the WRONG rule: report-section names are not in the storage forest, so the operand failed ordinary name resolution and drew the 8.4.2.1 unresolved-operand diagnostic. SR2 now has its own arm on COBOL1699, asked only AFTER resolution fails - a name also declared in ordinary storage resolves there (8.4.2.1) and is not an SR2 reference, which is the 13.15.3 SR16 scan's own reasoning; both consumers share the one report-section-exclusive name set.
